name: curlshot
description: Capture web page screenshots, PDFs and scrolling videos, or render HTML/Markdown to images, with the hosted CurlShot API.
content:
# CurlShot screenshots CurlShot (https://curlshot.com) is a hosted screenshot API. It renders a web page in a real browser and returns an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP), a PDF, or a video of the page scrolling (MP4, WebM, GIF). One HTTP request does it. ## When to Use - Use when the user wants a screenshot, full-page capture, or mobile/tablet view of a public URL. - Use when the user wants a PDF or a scrolling video (MP4, WebM, GIF) of a web page. - Use when the user wants their own HTML or Markdown rendered to an image or PDF (social cards, reports, previews). - Requires a CurlShot access key in the `CURLSHOT_API_KEY` environment variable. ## Before you start - The access key is read from `CURLSHOT_API_KEY`. If it is not set, ask the user to set it. Check current account eligibility and quotas at https://curlshot.com/register. - Never print the key, write it into a file in the repository, or put it in a link you show the user. - Only public pages work out of the box. Local and private network addresses (localhost, 192.168.x.x, ...) are refused: for a local page, send its HTML instead (see below). - Sending HTML or Markdown uploads that content to CurlShot. Confirm with the user before sending anything private or confidential. ## Take a screenshot ```bash curl --fail-with-body --max-time 60 -sS -G "https://curlshot.com/api/v1/screenshot" \ -H "X-Access-Key: $CURLSHOT_API_KEY" \ --data-urlencode "url=https://example.com" \ -d format=png \ --output screenshot.png ``` `-G` with `--data-urlencode` keeps the page address correctly encoded. Check response status and content type before treating the saved bytes as an image; an error may still be written to the output file. Use a new non-overwriting output path. Check the HTTP status: on an error the body is JSON with `error_code` and `error_message` instead of an image. ## Common options Add each option as one more `-d name=value` (GET) or as a field in a POST JSON body. | Want | Option | | --- | --- | | Whole page, top to bottom | `full_page=true` | | Phone or tablet view | `viewport_device=` (list: https://curlshot.com/docs/devices.md) | | Window size | `viewport_width=1440`, `viewport_height=900` | | Retina sharpness | `device_scale_factor=2` | | Dark theme | `dark_mode=true` | | One element only | `selector=` | | Output format | `format=png` / `jpeg` / `webp` / `pdf` / `mp4` / `webm` / `gif` | | Hide cookie banners and ads | `block_cookie_banners=true`, `block_ads=true` | | Wait for content | `wait_until=networkidle`, `delay=2`, `wait_for_selector=` | | Reuse a stored copy for free | `cache=true` | A misspelled option is rejected with `invalid_options` and a hint, never ignored. Every option: https://curlshot.com/docs/options.md ## Render your own HTML or Markdown POST JSON when the input is long: ```bash curl --fail-with-body --max-time 60 -sS -X POST "https://curlshot.com/api/v1/screenshot" \ -H "X-Access-Key: $CURLSHOT_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"html": "

Hello

", "format": "png", "viewport_width": 1200, "viewport_height": 630}' \ --output card.png ``` Use `"markdown": "..."` instead of `html` to render Markdown as a styled page, and `"format": "pdf"` for a PDF. ## Examples ### Example 1: Full-page mobile screenshot without cookie banners ```bash curl --fail-with-body --max-time 60 -sS -G "https://curlshot.com/api/v1/screenshot" \ -H "X-Access-Key: $CURLSHOT_API_KEY" \ --data-urlencode "url=https://example.com/pricing" \ -d viewport_device=iphone_15_pro \ -d full_page=true \ -d block_cookie_banners=true \ -d format=webp \ --output pricing-mobile.webp ``` Check https://curlshot.com/docs/devices.md for the exact preset names. ### Example 2: Save a page as PDF ```bash curl --fail-with-body --max-time 60 -sS -G "https://curlshot.com/api/v1/screenshot" \ -H "X-Access-Key: $CURLSHOT_API_KEY" \ --data-urlencode "url=https://example.com/docs" \ -d format=pdf \ --output docs.pdf ``` ## Usage and billing Verify current pricing, per-format charges, rate limits and account quota before use. Do not infer that failures/cache hits are free or that every render costs the same. Agree a batch cost cap and reconcile ambiguous outcomes before retrying. ## MCP alternative Agents with MCP support can use the hosted server instead of HTTP calls: `https://curlshot.com/api/mcp` (streamable HTTP, `Authorization: Bearer `), tools `take_screenshot` and `list_devices`. Setup per client is in the [curlshot-mcp README](https://github.com/SergiuPogor/curlshot-mcp). ## Limitations - Needs network access to `curlshot.com` and a CurlShot account key; it does not run a browser locally. - Pages behind a login, on localhost, or on private networks cannot be captured by URL; render their HTML instead. - Each successful render uses one screenshot from the account's monthly quota. - HTML and Markdown inputs are sent to a third-party service; do not send secrets or
